list: Official 55-trophy PS5 list: 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze; 28 hidden on PlayStation until earned. Names, descriptions and grades as PlayStation publishes them, as listed by PSNProfiles and Exophase.
note: GTA VI is unreleased, so no guide below can quote a played-through route. Every guide is written in my own words from the official trophy description and the game's announced systems (Lucia and Jason, Leonida and Vice City, partner play, Combat Focus), and it names its source beside it. Treat counts and steps as the plan to check against the cited guide once the game is out, not as played fact.

trophies.guide: The platinum pops automatically the moment the other 54 trophies are earned, so there is no separate task to do for it. Work through the roadmap in order — story first, then stranger strands, activities, collectibles, and finally the economy and combat feats — and use the checklist here to see exactly which trophies are left. Save the 100% completion trophy for last, since it overlaps with almost everything else.
trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); roadmap: this guide, built from the official descriptions

trophies.guide: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end. It is the first story mission, so follow the on-screen objectives, learn the movement, driving and partner controls as they are introduced, and do not skip the mission. If you are replaying, start it from the mission replay menu rather than a mid-mission save. Flagged missable only because it names one specific opening mission — finish it on your first run through the story.
trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 1 in order. Chapters unlock in sequence, so keep following the story markers for Lucia and Jason and complete each mission as it appears; side activities are optional at this point. The trophy pops on the chapter-complete screen. Do the chapter's named missions (such as Gone Fishing) as you meet them, since later chapters do not reopen earlier ones except through mission replay.
trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: IGN GTA 6 guide

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 2. By now the map opens up, so resist the urge to spend the whole chapter on side content: push the story markers forward until the chapter-complete screen appears. If a mission feels hard, use the mission's checkpoint restarts and the weapons and vehicles the game has given you so far rather than grinding elsewhere.
trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 3, which takes the story into Vice City itself. Keep a manual save at the start of the chapter so you can return to any mission you want to replay, and complete the chapter's missions in story order. The trophy is unmissable in the sense that the chapter always ends the same way once its missions are done — the work is simply playing them all.
trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.guide: Finish every story mission in Chapter 4. This is the last numbered chapter before the finale, so expect longer, harder missions and make sure your characters are stocked with armour, ammo and a good vehicle before each one. Complete the chapter's missions in order and the trophy pops at the chapter-complete screen, leaving only the final mission for the gold story trophy.
trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: IGN GTA 6 guide

trophies.guide: Complete the final story mission after Chapter 4. Before starting it, finish anything you want to do first in the story — the named-mission trophies and any one-time moments — because the finale is the point of no return for the story's structure. Stock up, save manually, then play the mission through to its ending cutscene; the gold trophy pops when the credits roll on the story.
trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Breakfast Run. Because the description names one mission, do it when it first appears in the story rather than leaving it for later, and play it through to its completion screen. If you fail a section, use the mission checkpoint to retry it immediately instead of quitting out to free roam, so the mission registers as completed in one clean run.
trophies.name: Trust
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission The Cartel Heist. Heist missions in GTA games usually have a setup phase and then the heist itself, so complete every setup objective the game gives you first, then run the heist to its end. Bring a fast getaway vehicle and keep your partner close during the escape, and retry from the checkpoint if the escape fails rather than abandoning the mission.
trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: IGN GTA 6 guide

trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Child's Play when it appears. Play it as the story presents it, following the mission markers and completing each objective in order until the mission-complete screen. Because it is a single named mission, do not skip it or leave it half-finished while you go off to do side content — finish it in the same session if you can.
trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Headliners. The title suggests a high-profile, public set-piece, so expect a scripted sequence with specific objectives rather than free combat: follow the prompts, stay with your partner, and complete each stage of the mission until it ends. Retry from checkpoints on failure so the mission completes cleanly.
trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission VCIA Takedown, set at the Vice City International Airport. Airport missions usually mix driving, stealth or combat in a restricted area, so follow the mission's route and objectives, use cover and Combat Focus when fighting, and complete the takedown objective the mission names. Finish it when it first appears in the story.
trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: IGN GTA 6 guide

trophies.guide: Complete the named story mission Operation Savage Glory. The name points to a large, military-style operation, so go in prepared: full armour, a good rifle, and a sturdy vehicle. Work through the operation's objectives in order, keep moving between cover, and use checkpoints to retry failed sections. Do it on your first story run, since it is a single named mission.
trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.guide: Reach 100% on the game's completion checklist, which in GTA games counts story missions, stranger missions, collectibles, activities and stunts together — not just the story. Treat this as the last trophy: finish the story, the eight stranger strands, the activities and the collectibles first, then open the in-game stats or checklist to find the few percent you are missing and mop those up. Check the roadmap's stage 6 list before grinding, so you do not repeat work you have already done.
trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); 100% checklist: Rockstar Games GTA VI official site and trailers; guide approach: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Pull off 250 stunts — jumps, near-misses, drifts, airtime and other stunt moves — across Leonida. The count is cumulative, so it builds up naturally if you drive fast and take jumps whenever you travel, but the fastest deliberate route is to find a jump or ramp you can repeat, hit it, and loop back. Mix stunt types rather than repeating one move, since the description counts completed stunts of any kind, and check your stats screen to watch the total climb toward 250.
trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); count 250 in the official description; guide approach: PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type in the game once — the count PlayStation tracks is 9 types. Work through the activity list systematically: racing, fishing, the shooting range, drone racing, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the other open-world activities, doing one session of each. Tick each type off in this guide as you try it, so you can see which types are still untried instead of guessing.
trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); activity types: Rockstar Games GTA VI official site and trailers; guide approach: IGN GTA 6 guide

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Go to a shooting range, pick a challenge, and learn its target pattern before chasing gold: accuracy beats speed on most range challenges, so take aimed shots, control recoil, and reload during lulls. Work through the challenges weapon by weapon, golding the easy ones first to learn the range, then returning for the hard ones with the best weapon for that challenge.
trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); count 42 as listed by PSNProfiles / Exophase; guide approach: PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at each of its 14 locations. Find the Top Fun van or drone-race marker at a location, learn the course on a practice run, then race to win: cut corners where the course allows, keep the drone low and steady through gates, and memorise the turns. Work location by location and tick each win off here, since the trophy needs a win everywhere, not just 14 wins at one place.
trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); locations count 14 as listed by PSNProfiles / Exophase; guide approach: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different race events, not the same race 20 times. Try the race types the game offers (street, off-road, boat, air and drone races where available), pick a vehicle suited to each race, and learn the route on a first attempt before pushing for the win. Keep a list of the races you have won so you do not repeat one that already counts, and use the easiest difficulty or assists the race allows while you learn each course.
trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); count 20 in the official description; guide approach: IGN GTA 6 guide

trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find Cal at a fishing spot, accept his challenge, and fish the way the challenge scores it — usually the biggest catch, the most fish, or the best fish in a time limit. Use the best rod and bait you have, watch the line tension so it does not snap, and reel steadily rather than yanking. If you lose, challenge him again at the same spot; the trophy only needs one win.
trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.guide: Find an arcade machine — in an arcade, a bar or another venue — and complete one full arcade game. Pick the simplest game on offer for your first try, learn its controls in the first minute, and play it through to its end screen rather than quitting mid-game. Any completed arcade game counts, so there is no need to chase a high score; finishing is the requirement.
trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's mission strand through to its final mission. Stranger and side-character strands unlock as you meet the character in free roam or through the story, so follow Andy's markers whenever they appear and finish each mission in the strand in order. The trophy pops on the final mission's completion screen, so keep doing Andy's missions until no more appear for him.
trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: IGN GTA 6 guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's mission strand through to its final mission. Meet Kenton where his strand begins, then work through his missions in order, doing each one as it appears. Side strands can be easy to lose track of, so use this checklist and the in-game map markers to see whether Kenton still has a mission waiting, and finish the strand before the finale if you can.
trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete Billy's mission strand through to its final mission. Follow Billy's markers as they appear, complete each mission in order, and do not leave the strand half-finished for a long stretch — returning later is fine, but finishing the strand promptly keeps the story and side content from tangling. The trophy pops when Billy's final mission ends.
trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 separate stranger mission strands across Leonida — eight different strangers, each with their own short chain of missions. Explore the map and watch for stranger markers (usually a question mark or a named character icon), start each strand you find, and finish it before moving on. Eight strands is the count in the description, so keep a running tally here; the stranger trophies for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone each count as one of the eight.
trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); count 8 in the official description; guide approach: IGN GTA 6 guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's mission strand through to its final mission. Find Randy's strand, work through its missions in the order the game gives them, and finish the last one. If Randy's marker is not showing, explore the area his strand is tied to or advance the story a little — stranger strands often unlock after a story beat — then return and complete it.
trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's mission strand through to its final mission. Follow Tyrone's missions in order from first meeting to finale, completing each one as it appears. As with the other named stranger trophies, the work is simply finishing the whole strand; use the checklist to confirm Tyrone's strand is done, since it also counts toward the eight stranger strands.
trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at all 18 meditation spots across Leonida. Meditation spots are quiet scenic locations; visit each one, start the meditation prompt, and let the session finish. Work through the map region by region — Vice City, the coast, the wetlands and the interior — and tick each spot off here as you find it, since the trophy needs every spot, and a missed one is hard to spot later without a checklist.
trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); spots count 18 as listed by PSNProfiles / Exophase; guide approach: PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Find Bret, take his hunting request, and follow his clues to the animal's territory — unique animals in GTA games usually appear in one specific area at a specific time or under specific conditions. Track it quietly, use a scoped rifle, and take a clean shot; if it escapes, return to the same area and try again rather than hunting random animals elsewhere.
trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: IGN GTA 6 guide

trophies.guide: Complete 3 full collectible card sets. Cards are scattered across Leonida — in shops, interiors, and hidden spots — so collect them as you explore and keep track of which sets are close to complete. Trade or buy the missing cards for a set where the game allows it, and focus on finishing three sets rather than starting many; a set only counts when every card in it is collected.
trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); count 3 in the official description; guide approach: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It feature at 100 different locations across Leonida. WAiNK It is the game's photo or check-in style activity, so open it at landmarks, businesses, viewpoints and other marked spots, and use it once per location. Work through the map systematically and tick locations off here — 100 is a large count, so fold this into your exploration for the 52 areas rather than treating it as a separate grind at the end.
trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); count 100 in the official description; guide approach: PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges of any kind — the game's challenge list covers driving, shooting, exploration and activity challenges. Open the challenges menu, pick the easiest unfinished ones first (short, low-skill challenges), and work through them in batches. The count is cumulative across all challenge types, so mix types to keep it moving, and check the menu regularly to see how many of the 50 you have banked.
trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); count 50 in the official description; guide approach: IGN GTA 6 guide

trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, build a 4-star wanted level, then lose the police and escape. Get wanted by committing crimes in view of police, keep your partner in the vehicle or on foot with you, and break line of sight — drive fast through alleys, switch vehicles, or hide until the wanted stars flash and clear. Do this as a pair: if your partner is left behind or the wanted level drops below 4 stars first, it will not count, so start the escape only at 4 stars with your partner present.
trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); partner system: Rockstar Games GTA VI official site and trailers; guide approach: PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner, rob three shops in a row without ever losing your wanted level between them. Plan a route with three close shops, rob the first, leave with the police chasing you, and go straight to the next shop while still wanted — do not hide or wait for the heat to die down. Keep a fast car ready outside each shop, grab the cash quickly, and repeat a third time; the trophy pops after the third robbery while you are still wanted.
trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles — drive or ride each one, and it registers as discovered. Try every vehicle type you meet: cars, bikes, boats, planes, trucks and special vehicles, and take a short drive in each new one rather than just looking at it. Visit car parks, dealerships, docks and airports, and keep an eye on your discovered count in the stats menu; the count is cumulative, so it grows naturally if you try new vehicles instead of always taking the same car.
trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); count 100 in the official description; guide approach: IGN GTA 6 guide

trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: In one single use of Combat Focus, take down 5 enemies. Combat Focus is the game's slow-motion aiming mode, so activate it in a fight with at least five enemies close together — a gang shootout or a police standoff works well — and line up headshots while time is slowed. Do not let the mode end before the fifth takedown: plan your targets before activating it, and reload or switch weapons only if you must, since the count resets when Combat Focus ends.
trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); Combat Focus: Rockstar Games GTA VI official site and trailers; guide approach: PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport — leave the airport in a plane without following a scheduled flight. Get to the airfield, take a plane from the runway or a hangar, and take off. Expect police attention once you are airborne without clearance, so take off quickly, gain height, and fly away from the airport; the trophy is about the departure itself, not about landing somewhere specific.
trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: The description is a joke about Rhinos — the tank. Get into a Rhino tank (usually found at a military base or in a specific mission or location) and use it: drive it, fire its cannon, and survive the wanted level that follows. Tanks are slow and attract heavy police attention, so plan a route, use the cannon on pursuing vehicles, and stay in the tank long enough for the trophy's condition to register.
trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: IGN GTA 6 guide

trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected at any point. Go in quiet: enter when the store is calm, avoid the cameras and the staff's line of sight, take the jewelry quickly, and leave before anyone raises the alarm. Do not draw a weapon or smash a case in view of anyone, and have a getaway vehicle parked close by. If you are spotted, leave and try again — detection at any stage fails the attempt.
trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one. Bank vault robberies are the bigger, planned robberies: scout the bank, get inside, open the vault, take the cash and escape the police response. Do them one at a time, with a getaway vehicle and an escape route planned before you start, and count each successful escape here — five completed vault robberies earn the silver trophy.
trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); count 5 in the official description; guide approach: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks drive set routes around Leonida, so find one on the road, stop it — block it, shoot its tyres, or force the driver out — then take the cash from the back and escape before the police arrive in force. Have a fast getaway car ready and break line of sight quickly; the escape is half the trophy.
trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: IGN GTA 6 guide

trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — every named district, town, beach, swamp and stretch of countryside on the map. Drive, fly or boat through each area until its name appears on screen and it registers as visited; the map's fog or the area list in the stats menu shows what is left. Work region by region and tick areas off here, and combine this with the WAiNK It locations and meditation spots so one trip covers several trophies at once.
trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); areas count 52 as listed by PSNProfiles / Exophase; guide approach: PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs in Leonida. Illegal operations are gang-run businesses or stash houses; find one for each gang, rob it, and escape. Learn which gang controls which territory from the map and from the game's gang information, then work through the gangs one by one and tick each off here — the trophy needs every gang, so one missed gang means no trophy.
trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); gangs count 9 as listed by PSNProfiles / Exophase; guide approach: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Go to Ocean Beach in Vice City, find a bar or beachfront spot with a view, and order and enjoy a cocktail there. This is a quiet moment trophy, not a mission: visit the beachfront, sit or stand where the ocean view is in front of you, and use the drink prompt. Do it in daylight for the view, and do not rush off mid-drink — let the animation finish so it registers.
trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: IGN GTA 6 guide

trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Drive a vehicle out of a showroom by smashing through its glass front, in classic GTA style. Find a vehicle showroom, get into a car inside it, and drive straight out through the window or glass wall. Pick a sturdy car, line up a straight run at the glass, and accelerate through it — the trophy is about the smash-and-exit itself, so commit to the run rather than nudging the glass.
trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and bowl — the description's 'follow-through' points to completing a proper bowling throw there. Find the alley, start a game, aim your bowl, and follow through on the throw until the ball rolls down the lane. You do not need a strike or a high score for this one; completing the bowling action at this specific alley is the requirement.
trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: This is a partnership trophy — a moment with your partner that reaches a wide audience in the game's world, most likely through the in-game social media or fame system. Play partner activities together, build your duo's following or reputation, and look for the partnership event or post the game prompts you with. Follow the partner prompts when they appear rather than ignoring them, since the trophy is tied to that shared moment.
trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); partner and social systems: Rockstar Games GTA VI official site and trailers; guide approach: IGN GTA 6 guide

trophies.guide: Make choices — the count PlayStation tracks for this trophy is 500, so this is a long cumulative trophy about decisions made across the game: dialogue choices, mission choices, and other decisions the game presents. Say yes or no, pick a side, and keep playing: the count builds up over a full playthrough and beyond, so do not try to grind it in one session. Check the stats menu to see how many choices you have made, and keep choosing whenever the game asks.
trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); count 500 as listed by PSNProfiles / Exophase; guide approach: PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — fail something once, then succeed at the same thing on the next attempt. The simplest reliable way is to attempt a challenge or mission section, fail it, and immediately retry it and succeed. Do not overthink which activity counts: pick a short, repeatable challenge you can fail and then pass, fail once on purpose if you must, and then complete it on the second attempt.
trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PSNProfiles GTA VI trophy guide

trophies.guide: Witness something strange — a random, weird event in Leonida. These trophies in GTA games usually pop when you stumble on an easter egg, a strange encounter, or an unusual random event while exploring. Explore off the beaten path, visit odd locations at different times of day, and pay attention to strange NPCs and scenes; when something genuinely odd happens, the trophy pops. There is no single location in the description, so exploration is the method.
trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: IGN GTA 6 guide

trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone over with a melee drive-by — attack from a moving vehicle with a melee weapon. Get a passenger or drive slowly yourself, equip a melee weapon such as a bat, and swing at a pedestrian or enemy as you drive past them. Speed matters: drive past at a steady pace, time the swing as you pass, and repeat until the knockdown registers. Use a quiet road with pedestrians so you can line the pass up cleanly.
trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.source: PlayStation official trophy list (via PSNProfiles / Exophase); guide approach: PowerPyx trophy guide

trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills are the dirty cash from robberies and heists; take them to your laundering contacts, convert them in batches, and keep the clean money. The $250,000 is cumulative, so keep laundering after every big robbery instead of letting Marked Bills pile up, and check your laundering total in the stats or contacts menu to see how close you are.
trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar

trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops in Leonida — clothing, weapons, food, vehicles and any other shop counts toward the total. The $100,000 is cumulative across every shop, so just buy what you need as you play: weapons, ammo, armour, outfits and upgrades all count. If you are close at the end, buy an expensive item you actually want rather than wasting money, and check your spending total in the stats menu.
trophies.name: Treat Yo Self

trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties across Leonida. Garages are properties you buy to store vehicles; find each one on the map or through the property listings, save up, and buy them one by one. Work through the list and tick each garage off here — the trophy needs all eight, so keep buying until no garage property is left unowned, and use the money from laundering and robberies to fund them.

trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app on your in-game phone, find the vehicle registration option, and register vehicles you own or have discovered — ten different vehicles in total. Register each new vehicle you acquire as you go, so the count builds up naturally, and check the app to see how many of the 10 you have registered.
